chunks: I said to him: What is the intellect ('aql)? He said: That by which the All-beneficent is worshipped and the Gardens are attained.
He (the narrator) said: I said: Then that which was in Muawiya? So he said: That is the heinous cunning, that is the devilry — and it resembles the intellect but is not the intellect.

key_terms.الشَّيْطَنَة: Shaytana — devilry, diabolical cleverness, intelligence in the service of evil
key_terms.النَّكْرَاء: Nakra' — heinous cunning, malicious cleverness, shrewdness without moral foundation
key_terms.الْعَقْل: 'Aql — intellect, reason; in Shia theology, the faculty by which humans fulfill their religious obligations

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of 'aql (intellect) according to Imam al-Sadiq in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines true 'aql (intellect/reason) as the faculty by which God is worshipped and Paradise is attained — a divinely-oriented capacity for right action and knowledge. When asked about Muawiya's notorious political acumen, the Imam sharply distinguishes it as nakra' (malicious cunning) and shaytana (devilry), which merely resembles intellect but is fundamentally different. This hadith was transmitted in a context where Shia Muslims needed to distinguish divine guidance from worldly shrewdness, and where Muawiya represented the archetype of politically successful but morally corrupt leadership. The Imam's teaching emphasizes that the criterion for true intellect is its orientation toward God, not worldly effectiveness.

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Idrees, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from one of our companions, (It has been narrated) raising it to Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I said to himasws, ‘What is the ‘الْعَقْلَ’ (Aql- intellect?’ Heasws said: ‘Through which the Beneficent is worshipped with, and the Gardens are attained with’.
I said, ‘So that which was in Muawiya?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That is the heinous, that is the devilry, and it may disguise as the intellect, but it is not the intellect’.
